Kids News

Campus News

护眼主题校园讲座

Our eyes are very precious. They help us see colorful flowers, blue skies and interesting books. We use our eyes every day, so we must take good care of them.

On Nov.2, a speech was held on the campus. The subject was about how to protect eyes. A professional doctor told us a lot about eye protection.

What can we do? First, keep good reading posture. Sit straight. Keep the book about 30 centimeters away from our eyes. Don't read in bed or in the sun. Second, follow the 20-20-20 rule. Every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds. It helps our eyes relax. Third, stay away from phones and tablets. We can play outside instead. Playing and looking at green trees are great for our eyes. Fourth, do eye exercises carefully at school. Remember to wash our hands before touching our eyes.

Good eyes let us enjoy the beautiful world. Let's form good habits and look after our eyes every day.

中文导读 · 原刊左下11月2日，学校请来了专业眼科医生，为全校师生讲解了如何护眼与爱眼。眼睛是心灵的窗户，是我们观察世界的通道。每个同学要学会护眼四步骤：坐直看书，书本保持30厘米远；每20分钟用眼，望远20秒钟；远离手机和平板电脑，多进行室外运动；认真做眼保健操，记得先洗手。一起养成用眼的好习惯吧！

Growing Pains

Question:

学习时总分心，怎么办？

Hello, Mrs Zhang. I have trouble concentrating(专心) when I study. I always want to play with toys or look out of the window. It takes me very long to finish my homework. I'd like to know how I can focus better when I learn.
By Leo
Class Eight, Grade Four

These are the common(常见的) problems when studying. You can try these methods(方法):

  1. Clear your desk: Put away toys and interesting things before you start studying. Only keep books, pens and notebooks on your desk.
  2. Work for a short time and take a break: Keep studying for about twenty minutes, then take a short-time break. Do not play exciting(令人兴奋的) games during the break.
  3. Set your small goals: Tell yourself "I will finish this page first". Small goals make it easier to keep your mind on study.
  4. Give yourself a little praise(表扬): When you finish your task carefully, you can reward(奖励) yourself with some free time for your hobbies.

Hope these methods can help you stay focused and enjoy your study.

By Lily（张丽黎）

中文导读 · 原刊右下如果学习过程中，有时会分心，怎么办？老师给你支招：桌面上放和学习有关的物品；学习一段时间后可以休息一会儿；给自己设定一些小目标，逐一完成；阶段性奖励自己。学习也是有窍门的，就从学习习惯的养成开始吧！

Animals in China · 01

Chinese Alligators

Chinese alligators(扬子鳄) live only in China. They usually live in swamps(湿地). They eat fish, frogs, river snails, and other small animals. Although they are "alligators", they are shy and gentle. They look smaller than other kinds of alligators in size, so they are shy and they hardly(几乎不) attack people. When the weather is good, they like sunbathing(日光浴) by the river.

Chinese alligators have been on Earth since the time of the dinosaurs(恐龙), so they're also called living fossils(化石). However, There are only a few hundred left(剩下的) in the wild, due to human(人类) activities

Last year, I visited its reserve(保护区) in Zhejiang, and I was happy to see many Chinese alligators living peacefully(和平地) there. They are precious(宝贵的) treasures(宝贝) of China. Let's protect them!

Animals in China · 02

The Funny Golden Monkey

Do you know the Sichuan golden monkey(金丝猴)? It looks like a cool rock star(摇滚明星)! Its fur is golden and shiny. Its face is bright blue. Its nose points up(凸起). It looks like it is smelling nice food!

These monkeys like to play a lot. They jump between trees and run after(追逐) each other. Sometimes they sit together. They pick small bugs from each other's fur. It sounds yucky(恶心的), but they love it!

Baby monkeys sit on their mums' backs. If they fall down(摔下), they cry just like little kids. How funny!

Golden monkeys live in cold mountains in China. They eat leaves, fruit and flowers. They are special. We can only see them in China. Let's protect them!

Animals in China · 03

The Giant Panda

原刊此栏与麋鹿篇共用标题 “Animals in China”，此处加副标题以便检索

There are lots of animals in China, such as giant pandas, golden snub-nosed monkeys(金丝猴), snow leopards(雪豹) and so on.

I like the giant panda best. The giant panda is black and white. It has a round face, black patches around the eyes, ears, legs and shoulders with the rest of the body white. Wild pandas live in bamboo forests(竹林) in the mountains of southwestern China, mainly in Sichuan, Shanxi and Gansu. They like eating bamboos. Pandas eat them about 12 hours a day! How cute the pandas are! But the pandas are facing a survival crisis(生存危机), we can't cut down trees anymore.

Animals in China · 04

The Milu Deer (Sibuxiang)

原刊此栏与熊猫篇共用标题 “Animals in China”，此处加副标题以便检索

Do you know there is a special animal in China called Sibuxiang(四不像)? They are rare and lovely animals from China — milu deer. They are China's first-class protected animals.

Milu deer are mammals(哺乳动物). They are a special kind of deer, but they look quite different from other deer. They have the head of the horse, the antlers(鹿角) of the deer, the hooves(蹄子) of the cow and the tail of the donkey. That's why people give them the funny name Sibuxiang.

They like living in wetlands. Many live in nature reserves(自然保护区). They eat grass, reeds(芦苇) and water plants(水草). They live in groups(群居). They are good at swimming. They are gentle(温顺的). There are over 14,000 milu deer on the Earth now. Most of them live in China.

What can we do to help? We can learn about milu deer. Don't disturb(打扰) them. We should protect wetlands and nature, and love wild animals.
